node: Optical interconnect compound-semiconductor stack: lasers, InP substrates, epitaxy, silicon photonics, and transceiver assembly
summary: Layer 1B expands the US-listed universe around the optical compound-semiconductor stack with a deliberate underfollowed lens. The most direct chokepoint candidate is AXTI at the InP/GaAs/GaN substrate layer. MTSI sits one layer above as a photonic semiconductor and CW laser supplier for 1.6T silicon-photonics modules. POET is a speculative small-cap optical-engine / photonic-integration candidate that could matter if wafer-scale assembly becomes a throughput bottleneck. LITE is included as a high-attention reference anchor because its filings explicitly tie high-speed laser chips, transceivers, cloud data centers, and AI/ML applications together. This is a research universe only, not a buy/sell list.
